faq.question: What does NEXSTACK AI focus on?
faq.answer: Our product directions include AI companion toys, AI office assistants and AI glasses. Our development work also includes AI Agent workflows.

faq.question: Who should contact you?
faq.answer: Business decision-makers can contact us about a product idea, office task or custom AI workflow requirement.

faq.question: Can I request custom development?
faq.answer: Yes. Share the product features, software tasks or branding changes you need. The proposed scope and project conditions are discussed before work begins.

faq.question: Do you discuss OEM and ODM projects?
faq.answer: Yes. Send us your product and manufacturing requirements. The development scope, production arrangement and commercial conditions need to be confirmed for your project.

faq.question: Can I see a demonstration or request a sample?
faq.answer: Contact us about the product you are considering. Available demonstrations, sample options and product details need to be confirmed for that requirement.

faq.question: What should I define for a companion toy?
faq.answer: Start with the intended age group, interaction, content and memory requirements. Include the target market and how the product will be evaluated.

faq.question: Can an office assistant use company information?
faq.answer: Describe the information and tasks involved. We can discuss the required access, permissions and development approach for your project.

faq.question: What functions do your AI glasses support?
faq.answer: Product functions need to be confirmed for the proposed model. Tell us the wearable tasks, interaction and target market you have in mind.

faq.question: Can I request a particular deployment arrangement?
faq.answer: Include your hosting and data-handling requirements in the brief. Feasibility, dependencies and costs need to be assessed for the proposed scope.

faq.question: What are the minimum order quantity and delivery time?
faq.answer: These need to be confirmed for the product and project scope. Include your expected quantity and target date when you contact us.

faq.question: Which certifications apply?
faq.answer: Requirements depend on the product, intended users and destination market. Product-specific documentation and its status need to be verified before a supply commitment.

faq.question: How do I start?
faq.answer: Submit the contact form with your company details and requirement. You can also contact us by email or WhatsApp.

privacy.title: Who handles your information
privacy.body: To confirm: Confirm the entity or individual responsible for the website and enquiries, its address and applicable privacy contact.

privacy.title: Information you provide
privacy.body: The contact form asks for your name, company, phone or WhatsApp number, email address and project requirements. You may also provide information when contacting us directly by email or WhatsApp.

privacy.title: How enquiries are handled
privacy.body: We use the details you provide to respond to your enquiry and discuss the proposed project. The website forwards contact form submissions by email. It does not save enquiry content to a website database or file.

privacy.title: Service providers and other recipients
privacy.body: The current enquiry setup uses Gmail to send notifications and a Hotmail mailbox to receive them. Email and WhatsApp providers process communications under their own terms.

privacy.title: Retention
privacy.body: To confirm: Define how long enquiries, correspondence and operational records are retained, who can access them, and the deletion process.

privacy.title: Cookies and technical information
privacy.body: The current website implementation has no analytics scripts or non-essential cookies. Hosting and server operations may generate technical records.

privacy.title: International processing
privacy.body: To confirm: Describe relevant processing locations, transfers and applicable safeguards based on the confirmed providers and operating entity.

privacy.title: Requests about your information
privacy.body: Contact us at dalelai0776@gmail.com about your information or this policy.

privacy.title: Changes to this policy
privacy.body: We will update this page when the website's information practices change.
